text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa~! Yukino-chan, great job~~!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Yukino Bijin's pretty good, isn't 
she?"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"I thought she was just an idol, but she 
looks like she could actually be promising 
in the Classic year."

text_block_list.name: Person with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
"...Yukino Bijin, huh. Well, she's cute 
and all, but—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank goodness. I managed to run 
all the way to the end...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehe.

text_block_list.name: Person with a Camera
text_block_list.text: (Ba-dum...!)

text_block_list.name: Person with a Camera
text_block_list.text:
T-That smile just now...!! I have to 
capture it in a photo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Great job today, Yuki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu-chan, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yuki-chan, you really are amazing! You 
mentioned before how tough it is to win 
the Triple Tiara, but...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Yuki-chan, you can 
definitely, definitely win it~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yup. Thank you kindly!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
...And you know, Yuki-chan. There's 
something I need to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think we'll be able to meet up 
like this for a little while."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?! Why's that?!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta push myself even harder in 
figure skating practice, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I won't let Yuki-chan beat me either!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu-chan...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. In that case, we'd better both put 
up even better results.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Next time we meet, let's hold our heads 
high!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Oh, but we're still LANEing 
normally, okay?
choice_data_list: Then I'll go see Mifuyu off.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Got it! Alright, I'll go get changed!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
—The truth is, I've always looked up to 
Yuki-chan. Well, I mean, I still do, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yuki-chan was great at skating too, 
pulling off jumps so effortlessly... I was 
so jealous.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
She's always so cool, truly. She's my 
hero.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I came to watch today. Thank 
you very much!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Did Mifuyu-chan already leave!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad we got to talk properly. 
Mifuyu-chan always gives me confidence, 
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I guess so. But hearing again that we 
won't see each other for a while... does 
feel pretty lonely."
choice_data_list: Even so, I have to keep moving forward.
Even so, we have to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Next year is finally the Classic year... 
I'm takin' on the Triple Tiara route!
choice_data_list: First up is the Oka Sho!
First up is the Oka Sho, right!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Watch over me, Mifuyu-chan!
